page.overview:
Who is Klovis the Redeemer?

Klovis the Redeemer is a noble of House Cawdor and a particularly fanatical and homicidal Redemptionist priest of the Ecclesiarchy from the Hive World of Necromunda.

Based in Hive Primus, the capital hive city of Necromunda, the noble House Cawdor is the stronghold of the Adeptus Ministorum's fanatical Cult of Redemption, whose prophets foretell of universal destruction and salvation from sin through death in the Emperor's service.

Although the cult has its adherents throughout the hive city, in House Cawdor its fanatical take on the theology of the Imperial Creed has attained the status of an official religion. For this reason, the house is also known as the "House of Redemption." Members of House Cawdor are forbidden to show their faces in public, and so they wear elaborate masks to conceal their identities.

Klovis the Redeemer is a legend in his own lifetime and a force to be reckoned with. From his fortress in the Ash Wastes, two solar weeks' journey from Hive Primus, Klovis launches crusades which are notorious for the slaughter they bring.
